summary: Verified the safeStorage fix for the ErrorBoundary bug caused by localStorage SecurityError in cross-origin/sandboxed iframes. Simulated blocked storage via page.add_init_script overriding window.localStorage getter to throw SecurityError. Tested all 5 public routes in both BLOCKED and NORMAL modes, plus regression flows (cookie consent, lang toggle persistence, menu search/category filter, gallery lightbox, reservation form). Bug FIX CONFIRMED working end-to-end. Frontend testing only per request.

issues: Date and time inputs use native browser <input type=date/time> pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar/time components used elsewhere in the codebase. Not part of the current bug fix scope but worth polishing.

critical_code_review_comments: safeStorage wrapper in /app/frontend/src/lib/storage.js is correct - try/catch around both get and set. Grep verified only storage.js touches window.localStorage; SiteContext and CookieConsent both consume safeStorage. No sessionStorage usage anywhere.
ErrorBoundary is a minimal class component with proper getDerivedStateFromError; data-testid='error-boundary' present and used to verify absence.

Minor observation: in blocked-storage mode, immediately after clicking cookie-accept-btn the banner element still exists in DOM for ~500ms due to AnimatePresence exit animation (not a real bug - setVisible(false) fires correctly, animation completes shortly after).
Consider also wrapping any future navigator.storage / IndexedDB usage similarly if introduced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for localStorage SecurityError -> ErrorBoundary is verified in iteration 6. Blocked-storage simulation used: page.add_init_script with Object.defineProperty(window,'localStorage',{get(){throw new DOMException('...','SecurityError')}}). Verified pages: /, /menu, /galeri, /rezervasyon, /iletisim. In blocked mode: no error-boundary, hero-title visible, 4 menu categories render, cookie banner appears (visible=true fallback), lang-toggle switches TR<->EN, no pageerrors. In normal mode: cookie accept persists across reload, cdn_lang persists (stored='en'), menu search 'kahve' filters, gallery lightbox opens/closes via close btn (16 gallery-photo items), reservation form has all data-testids (reservation-name-input, phone-input, date-input, time-input, guests-input, submit-btn, form). Correct testids for future runs: gallery-photo-{i}, gallery-lightbox, lightbox-close-btn, lightbox-prev-btn, lightbox-next-btn, reservation-*-input (not -field).
rca of the issue: RCA (already fixed by main agent): SiteContext.js useState initializer and CookieConsent.js useState initializer called window.localStorage.getItem() synchronously during first render. In sandboxed cross-origin iframes with third-party storage blocked (Emergent preview iframe, Safari Intelligent Tracking Prevention, strict privacy modes), accessing window.localStorage throws DOMException('SecurityError'). The synchronous throw during React render propagated up and was caught by ErrorBoundary, showing the Turkish 'Bir seyler ters gitti' fallback screen. Mitigation: introduced /app/frontend/src/lib/storage.js safeStorage wrapper with try/catch on get/set; SiteContext and CookieConsent now use safeStorage instead of direct localStorage. Reproduction: page.add_init_script overriding localStorage getter to throw SecurityError -> before fix, error-boundary appears; after fix, all pages render normally. Verified: grep across /app/frontend/src confirms storage.js is the only remaining direct localStorage access.
